tido-anonymitet-poliser-skyddade-uppgift.label: none
tido-anonymitet-poliser-skyddade-uppgift.reason: SFS 2024:224 is the sunset provision that only repeals 28 a § polislagen on 2029-04-30; it implements no protection itself. The alias option is introduced in SFS 2024:223 and the secrecy in SFS 2024:225, which stay partial. The judge called it partial at low confidence and said it could arguably be none.

tido-starkta-larares-befogenheter::sfs-2.label: full
tido-starkta-larares-befogenheter::sfs-2.reason: Read in Prop. 2025/26:193: the amended 5 kap. 24 § drops utvisning ur undervisningslokalen (7 §) and kvarsittning (8 §) from the documentation duty ('en avskaffad dokumentationsskyldighet i dessa fall'), which is the documentation half of the promise. The other half (the teacher decides on the teaching) is enacted in SFS 2026:1242 and 2026:1243 ('undervisningen bestäms och leds av lärare eller förskollärare', Prop. 2025/26:194 and 193). Together the laws deliver the whole promise; the judge only saw this law's own text.

tido-starkta-larares-befogenheter::sfs-2.label: partial
tido-starkta-larares-befogenheter::sfs-2.reason: Covers the teacher-decides half; the documentation half is SFS 2026:1198.
tido-starkta-larares-befogenheter::sfs-2.missing_sv: Avskaffandet av dokumentationskravet för utvisning och kvarsittning finns i en annan lag (SFS 2026:1198).

tido-starkta-larares-befogenheter::sfs-2.label: partial
tido-starkta-larares-befogenheter::sfs-2.reason: Covers the teacher-decides half; the documentation half is SFS 2026:1198.
tido-starkta-larares-befogenheter::sfs-2.missing_sv: Avskaffandet av dokumentationskravet för utvisning och kvarsittning finns i en annan lag (SFS 2026:1198).

tido-utokat-kontaktforbud::sfs-2025-561.label: full
tido-utokat-kontaktforbud::sfs-2025-561.reason: The law delivers all three parts: larger areas for extended and especially extended bans, house searches for service, and bans to protect witnesses and complainants in legal proceedings (HC03123, section 6.2), where the extended bans can be combined with electronic monitoring (already in the act). The judge's partial rested on the word 'kraftigt' and a cut-off quote, neither a gap in the law.

tido-forlangd-preskription-utvisningsbes.label: full
tido-forlangd-preskription-utvisningsbes.reason: The promise is a longer OR abolished limitation period. The amended 12 kap. 22 § makes decisions outside the general courts lapse five years after departure (or later with a re-entry ban), which is the longer alternative; the limit to decisions not issued by a general court already existed in the old 22 § (HC0392), and court expulsions follow the re-entry ban. Neither is a gap.

tido-anonyma-vittnen::sfs-2024-1180.label: full
tido-anonyma-vittnen::sfs-2024-1180.reason: The v6 judge says the act is itself the new system for anonymous witnesses and only rates it medium because the description also mentions an inquiry task. Read in the proposition (Prop. 2024/25:20, section 2.1): court permission to hear a witness anonymously, conditions, public counsel. The promise only commits to introducing the system, and the law has been in force since 2025-01-01.

tido-forlangd-karensperiod-ny-asylansoka.label: none
tido-forlangd-karensperiod-ny-asylansoka.reason: The judge called it partial at low confidence by inference only; SFS 2025:225 extends how long a removal decision applies and the re-entry ban, and its own note finds no extension of the waiting time before a new asylum application, which is what the promise asks for.

tido-utokad-timplan-svenska-matematik::s.label: none
tido-utokad-timplan-svenska-matematik::s.reason: The judge called it partial, but the law (a ten-year compulsory school) does not expand the timetable with a focus on Swedish and mathematics, which is what the promise asks for; the expansion for those subjects is only an inquiry proposal.

tido-hemvisttid-atta-ar-medborgarskap::s.label: partial
tido-hemvisttid-atta-ar-medborgarskap::s.reason: The judge (low confidence) wrote that the eight-year rule is not visible, but the proposition (HD03175) does mention eight years; the truncated law text only fails to show it, so the note must not claim the rule is absent. Kept partial because the law text itself does not confirm it.
tido-hemvisttid-atta-ar-medborgarskap::s.missing_sv: Det synliga lagtextutdraget visar inte om åttaårsgränsen för hemvisttid ingår i lagen, så hur stor del av löftet lagen täcker är obekräftat.

tido-aterfall-straffas-hardare::sfs-2026.label: none
tido-aterfall-straffas-hardare::sfs-2026.reason: Only raises the minimum penalty for gross tax crime in a general penalty-scale increase; its own note finds nothing about recidivism.

tido-aterfall-straffas-hardare::sfs-2026.label: none
tido-aterfall-straffas-hardare::sfs-2026.reason: Only raises the minimum penalty for gross benefit fraud in a general penalty increase; its own note finds nothing about recidivism.

tido-oversyn-brottsskadeersattning-skade.label: none
tido-oversyn-brottsskadeersattning-skade.reason: Only lifts the garnishment ban for traffic-injury compensation when the claim is damages for crime; its own note says the core of the promise is in other laws.

tido-skarpt-hedersforstryck-lagstiftning.label: partial
tido-skarpt-hedersforstryck-lagstiftning.reason: Prop. 2024/25:189 only criminalises oskuldskontroller, oskuldsintyg and oskuldsingrepp. The judge note listed the promise's other parts (kontrollerande beteende, skärpta straffskalor, vite, preskription) as if the law contained them; they are not in this law.
tido-skarpt-hedersforstryck-lagstiftning.missing_sv: Lagen gäller oskuldskontroller, oskuldsintyg och oskuldsingrepp. Kontrollerande beteende, skärpta straffskalor för hedersförtryck och äktenskapstvång, vite för vårdnadshavare och förlängd preskriptionstid ingår inte i den.

val2022-s-foraldrar-skyldiga-medverka-i-.label: partial
val2022-s-foraldrar-skyldiga-medverka-i-.reason: Judge label kept (partial, medium); the override only corrects a typo in the judge's note ("ininför" to "inför").
val2022-s-foraldrar-skyldiga-medverka-i-.missing_sv: Lagen inför ingen generell skyldighet för alla föräldrar att medverka; den är en kompletterande möjlighet som gäller i första hand när frivilliga insatser inte räcker, med undantag för barn som är placerade eller vårdas utanför hemmet.

tido-fler-utvisningar-pa-grund-av-brott:.label: full
tido-fler-utvisningar-pa-grund-av-brott:.reason: Read in Prop. 2025/26:235 (summary and Bet. 2025/26:SfU33): the one amending law delivers five of the six parts: deportation as the main rule when the sentence is stricter than a fine (lower threshold), the balance tipped towards deportation (recidivists, via the tillkännagivande the proposition says it fulfils), the special requirements for those who arrived before 15 removed, enforcement obstacles no longer weighed by the court, longer and more often unlimited re-entry bans, and a duty for the prosecutor to seek deportation (8 a kap. 8 §, the judge's note that the duty is not in this law is wrong). The sixth part, utvisningsmen as mitigating, is described as already abolished in SOU 2025:54 and the proposition has nothing to change. In force 2026-09-01.

tido-langre-aterreseforbud::sfs-2026-125.label: full
tido-langre-aterreseforbud::sfs-2026-125.reason: The promise is that amendments making re-entry bans last longer are examined and proposed. Prop. 2025/26:235 proposes, and SFS 2026:1259 enacts (in force 2026-09-01), longer re-entry bans that more often have no time limit; the inquiry part was done by the inquiry behind SOU 2025:54 and the earlier SFS 2025:225 also lengthened bans. The judge only saw the visible law text, which is cut.

tido-kriminalisera-rymning::sfs-2026-924.label: full
tido-kriminalisera-rymning::sfs-2026-924.reason: Prop. 2025/26:181 criminalises escape from a kriminalvårdsanstalt, särskilt ungdomshem, häkte, arrest, undersökningsenhet, vårdenhet and förvar, and from anyone supervising such a deprivation of liberty; that is anstalt, häkte and the other forms of deprivation of liberty the promise names. Minor cases going unpunished is an ordinary limit, not a gap. Enacted by SFS 2026:924 (in force 2026-07-02), the judge's 'only listed forms' is the whole set of forms.

tido-ny-socialtjanstlag-brottsforebyggan.label: full
tido-ny-socialtjanstlag-brottsforebyggan.reason: Read in Prop. 2024/25:89: the new socialtjänstlag makes it an explicit duty for socialnämnden to work to prevent and counter crime (with a separate rule for children and young people and support for leaving a criminal lifestyle), lets the nämnd offer open services without a needs assessment, and the proposition describes co-location with familjecentraler as the way to reach people early. These are the three parts of the promise, enacted in the Socialtjänstlag (2025:400), in force 2025-07-01. The judge only saw a cut of the law text.

tido-hemliga-tvangsmedel-under-15::sfs-2.label: full
tido-hemliga-tvangsmedel-under-15::sfs-2.reason: The promise is a possibility to use secret coercive measures against children under 15 who commit serious crimes, through a review of LUL among others. Prop. 2024/25:175 and Bet. 2025/26:JuU2 enact exactly that: secret coercive measures in a § 31 LUL investigation for serious crimes (four-year penalty threshold) and preventive measures, through this LUL amendment together with the sibling laws on rättegångsbalken, hemlig dataavläsning and inhämtning (all in force 2025-10-01; some follow-up provisions only 2028 and 2030). The judge noted the material rules sit in other laws of the same proposition, which together are the delivery.

tido-insynsprincip-fristaende-skolor::sf.label: full
tido-insynsprincip-fristaende-skolor::sf.reason: The promise is an insynsprincip for independent schools that corresponds to the offentlighetsprincipen for municipal principals. Prop. 2025/26:191 (Offentlighetsprincipen med lättnadsregler för enskilda mindre huvudmän) introduces exactly that: the right to access public documents at legal-person private principals, which are treated like authorities under OSL, with matching changes in arkivlagen and skollagen (SFS 2026:714, 2026:715, 2026:716; in force 2027-01-01 and 2029-01-01). The relief rules for small principals and the exclusion of natural persons are limits of scope, not a different measure.

tido-minska-lararnas-administrativa-bord.label: full
tido-minska-lararnas-administrativa-bord.reason: Prop. 2025/26:196 (Tid för undervisningsuppdraget) is the broad review of the rules for teachers' working time: the teaching assignment is regulated, information to guardians is given when staff decide, utvecklingssamtal once per school year and the written plan limited to knowledge development (the limit on individual development plans), and the rules on documenting kränkande behandling are eased. Bet. 2025/26:UbU25 and the laws of the proposition (SFS 2026:1096 from 2026-08-01, later parts 2028) deliver it together; the judge noted that parts sit in the other law of the proposition. Note: the documentation cuts (individual development plans, utvecklingssamtal) are enacted in SFS 2026:1243 (in force 2028-07-02) and the kränkande behandling rules in SFS 2026:1096; the two laws deliver it together.

tido-tullverket-brottsbekampande-uppgift.label: full
tido-tullverket-brottsbekampande-uppgift.reason: The promise has three parts, delivered by laws on two propositions: the new Tullbefogenhetslag (SFS 2024:710, in force 2024-11-07) widens Tullverket's crime-fighting role and powers, Bet. 2024/25:SkU2 says the tillkännagivande on a comprehensive review of the agency's means to fight crime is met, and SFS 2025:638 (in force 2025-09-01) criminalises export of stolen goods (utförselhäleri) with matching changes in the Tullbefogenhetslag. The judge saw each law alone.

tido-rektors-ansvar-trygghet-studiero-sk.label: full
tido-rektors-ansvar-trygghet-studiero-sk.reason: Read in Prop. 2025/26:193: rektor's and the principal's responsibility for trygghet och studiero is clarified in skollagen, the temporary placement within and outside the unit and suspension can last longer, rektor decides on temporary placement and denial of access, and the rektor 'tar fram och beslutar om' the school-wide skolregler (5 kap. 5 §). Together these are the four parts of the promise, in SFS 2026:1198 (in force 2026-08-01). The judge saw only a cut of the law text.

tido-vinstutdelning-forbud-nya-friskolor.label: full
tido-vinstutdelning-forbud-nya-friskolor.reason: Prop. 2025/26:292 introduces a ban on value transfers in three situations, new establishment and change of ownership among them, with separate accounting and sanction fees; the inquiry the promise mentions (Utredningen om vinst i skolan, Dir. 2023:109) was appointed and reported in SOU 2025:37. The ban covers all value transfers, which includes profit distribution, so it is wider than the promise, not weaker. SFS 2026:1634 applies from 2027-07-01.

tido-sanktionstrappa-friskolor::sfs-2026.label: full
tido-sanktionstrappa-friskolor::sfs-2026.reason: Prop. 2025/26:292 (chapter 9, Tillsynsmyndigheterna ska få skarpare sanktionsmöjligheter) delivers the ladder: viten that take the whole group's finances into account, sanktionsavgifter as a complement to viten, a ban on value transfers after a supervisory order (the limit on distribution after quality failings), and state measures for rectification (tvångsförvaltning) in exceptional cases for independent schools. SFS 2026:1634 applies from 2027-07-01.

tido-implementera-elmarknadsdirektivet::.label: full
tido-implementera-elmarknadsdirektivet::.reason: Prop. 2025/26:240 replaces the ellagen with a new Elmarknadslag (SFS 2026:1281, in force 2027-01-01) that clarifies the system responsibility of grid companies, replaces the balance responsibility with two roles, and adds energy sharing to implement the revised electricity market directive; that is the clearer division of responsibility the promise asks for. The 2023 law (SFS 2023:238) already implemented the delivery and aggregation parts.

tido-begransa-humanitara-skyddsgrunden::.label: full
tido-begransa-humanitara-skyddsgrunden::.reason: Read in Prop. 2023/24:18 and Bet. 2020/21:SfU28. The proposition's title and purpose is to limit permits on humanitarian grounds: the 'särskilt ömmande omständigheter' ground (5 kap. 6 § andra stycket utlänningslagen) is removed and children instead get permits on 'synnerligen ömmande omständigheter' with a lower threshold than for adults, the same wording as the committee's own proposal in SfU28 (the initiative raised by M, SD, KD and L on 4 May 2021, prot. 2020/21:34; the Tidö text dates it 3 May). SFS 2023:652 enacts it (amends 5 kap. 3, 3 a, 3 d, 6 and 17 a §§, in force 2023-12-01). The promise is a proposition that corresponds to the committee initiative on this ground, so the family-reunification changes in the same law do not reduce it. The judge doubted the match only because the law does not name the initiative.

tido-forvaringsdom::sfs-2026-252.label: full
tido-forvaringsdom::sfs-2026-252.reason: Read in Prop. 2025/26:95: the proposition introduces the new påföljd säkerhetsförvaring in a new 33 kap. brottsbalken (SFS 2026:253, in force 2026-04-15; missing from the SFS store because the register entry has no Förarbeten) and a new enforcement act (SFS 2026:252). The promise is that the new påföljd is introduced; the two laws together do it. Livstidsstraff is untouched.

tido-forvantansdokument-ordningsregler-k.label: partial
tido-forvantansdokument-ordningsregler-k.reason: Judge label kept (partial, medium). Read in Prop. 2025/26:193: skolregler with a plan for consequences and a förväntansdokument are enacted (in force 2026-08-01), but the government decided against a national requirement that pupils and guardians sign the document and left the practical work to local conditions, and the zero-tolerance wording is not in the law text. The promise names the signing, so the law covers it only partly.
tido-forvantansdokument-ordningsregler-k.missing_sv: Regeringen avstod i propositionen från ett nationellt krav på att elever och vårdnadshavare ska skriva under förväntansdokumentet och lät det avgöras lokalt. Förväntansdokumentet gäller inte fritidshemmet.

tido-aterkrav-skolpeng-brott::sfs-2026-1.label: partial
tido-aterkrav-skolpeng-brott::sfs-2026-1.reason: Judge label kept (partial, medium). Read in Prop. 2025/26:292: 26 b kap. 3-6 §§ skollagen make a huvudman repayable for bidrag paid on wrong grounds, for tilläggsbelopp not used for the stödåtgärder it was granted for, and for bidrag used in a way that is a crime with a penalty stricter than böter, and the municipality may reclaim it. The trigger is how the money was used, not a conviction of a representative, and use for activities other than school activity is not a ground of its own, so the promise's two named triggers are only partly delivered.
tido-aterkrav-skolpeng-brott::sfs-2026-1.missing_sv: Återbetalningsskyldigheten gäller bidrag som använts i brott (brott med strängare straff än böter), bidrag på felaktig grund och tilläggsbelopp som inte använts till stödåtgärderna, och kommunen får kräva tillbaka beloppet. Den knyts till hur pengarna använts och inte till att en företrädare dömts.

val2022-l-sank-arbetsgivaravgiften-for-a.label: none
val2022-l-sank-arbetsgivaravgiften-for-a.reason: SFS 2024:1158 is the small-firm cut (vaxa-stod, first two employees of one-person firms), not aimed at hiring young people; the youth cut is the 2026 law reached through Prop. 2025/26:66.

val2022-m-skriva-av-studielan-poliser::s.label: full
val2022-m-skriva-av-studielan-poliser::s.reason: Read in Prop. 2025/26:237 (HD03237): SFS 2026:1394 amends the studiestödslagen and adds 4 kap. 25 a §, under which the government or the authority it appoints may issue rules that student loans may be written off for borrowers who have completed the basic police education, and 4 kap. 13 a § on lowering the annual amount meanwhile. This is the write-off the promise asks for; the details (service time) are left to an ordinance, which is stated in the reasoning. The judge saw a truncated extract and called it partial at medium confidence.

val2022-sd-underlatta-jakt-i-omraden-med.label: none
val2022-sd-underlatta-jakt-i-omraden-med.reason: SFS 2026:832 simplifies hunting in general (hunting on public water, seal hunting in the economic zone by notification, tracking and putting down game for animal welfare). The judge itself notes that it contains no measure for areas with large game populations, which is what the promise asks for, so it does not count as delivery. The proposition stays as evidence of ongoing work.

val2022-l-nationellt-stod-for-skyddade-b.label: none
val2022-l-nationellt-stod-for-skyddade-b.reason: SFS 2024:79 only gives a legal basis to place a child in protected housing without a guardian's consent (1 kap. 1 §). It introduces no national support for shelters, which is what the promise asks for, so it does not count as delivery; the proposition stays as evidence of ongoing work.

val2022-l-nationellt-stod-for-skyddade-b.label: none
val2022-l-nationellt-stod-for-skyddade-b.reason: SFS 2024:85 puts protected housing in the Social Services Act as a municipal duty (an insats), with the permit and notification duties elsewhere. The judge note finds no national funding or coordination in it, which is what the promise asks for, so it does not count as delivery; the proposition stays as evidence of ongoing work.

val2022-sd-forbjud-deltagande-i-terroror.label: full
val2022-sd-forbjud-deltagande-i-terroror.reason: Read in Prop. 2022/23:73 and the law: the new 4 a § of terroristbrottslagen makes participation in a terrorist organisation an offence and 5 § keeps association (samröre) punishable, which is exactly the promised ban on participation in and association with terrorist organisations. The judge agreed on the label but at medium confidence only.

val2022-sd-sarskilt-hedersbrott::sfs-202.label: none
val2022-sd-sarskilt-hedersbrott::sfs-202.reason: Read in Prop. 2025/26:213: SFS 2026:950 changes 2 kap. 5 §, 4 kap. 4 c, 4 d and 10 §§ brottsbalken, the existing offences on marriage coercion and a new offence on travel for child marriage. It creates no offence of hedersbrott as such, which is what the promise asks for, so it is not delivery; the proposition stays as evidence of ongoing work. The judge called it partial at low confidence.

val2022-m-vistelseforbud-vald-nara-relat.label: partial
val2022-m-vistelseforbud-vald-nara-relat.reason: Read in Prop. 2024/25:123: SFS 2025:561 amends the contact ban act with a presumption of an extended contact ban after serious crimes against a close person and wider prohibited areas. That is related protection for victims of partner violence but not a stay ban for the offender, so partial. Only the wording of the note is replaced.
val2022-m-vistelseforbud-vald-nara-relat.missing_sv: Lagen ger ett utvidgat kontaktförbud som kan gälla större områden, till exempel kring den utsattas bostad, men den ger ingen särskild form av vistelseförbud för den som dömts för våld i nära relation.

val2022-sd-sank-skatten-pa-diesel-for-jo.label: partial
val2022-sd-sank-skatten-pa-diesel-for-jo.reason: Read in Prop. 2022/23:69: SFS 2023:361 raises the relief from carbon dioxide and energy tax on diesel used in agriculture, forestry and aquaculture for the second half of 2023, which delivers the diesel half of the promise. The judge note wrongly counted the time limit against it; the promise asks for no particular duration. The general payroll fee (allmän löneavgift) is untouched.
val2022-sd-sank-skatten-pa-diesel-for-jo.missing_sv: Lagen sänker dieselskatten för jord- och skogsbruket men inte den allmänna löneavgiften.

val2022-sd-sank-skatten-pa-diesel-for-jo.label: partial
val2022-sd-sank-skatten-pa-diesel-for-jo.reason: Read in Prop. 2023/24:24: SFS 2023:810 keeps the raised diesel relief for agriculture, forestry and aquaculture through 2024 alongside a general diesel tax cut. It delivers the diesel half of the promise; the general payroll fee (allmän löneavgift) is untouched. Only the wording of the note is replaced.
val2022-sd-sank-skatten-pa-diesel-for-jo.missing_sv: Lagen sänker dieselskatten för jord- och skogsbruket men inte den allmänna löneavgiften.

val2022-m-forenkla-3-12-reglerna::sfs-20.label: full
val2022-m-forenkla-3-12-reglerna::sfs-20.reason: Read in Prop. 2025/26:1 section 13.8.4 and the law text for 57 kap. inkomstskattelagen: a grundbelopp of four inkomstbasbelopp replaces the förenklingsregel, so the two alternative ways of computing gränsbeloppet become one, with further simplifications of the lönebaserat utrymme and related rules. That is the promised simplification of the 3:12 rules. The law is not reached by the SFS step because it was passed through the budget proposition, so the entry is added by hand.

tido-pausa-omprovning-vattenkraft-nytt-r.label: partial
tido-pausa-omprovning-vattenkraft-nytt-r.reason: Read in Prop. 2025/26:202: the amended miljobalken lets reconsideration for modern environmental conditions lower the requirements for hydropower with an essential public interest, to weigh the need for a national effective supply of hydropower electricity against water-environment measures. That is the "new regelverk where electricity supply weighs very heavily" half of the promise. The pause half is not part of this law. The judge called it none because it looked only for a pause; the proposition text supports partial.

val2022-kd-missfirmelse-mot-tjansteman::.label: full
val2022-kd-missfirmelse-mot-tjansteman::.reason: Read in Prop. 2024/25:141 and Bet. 2024/25:JuU29: a new offence, forolamping mot tjansteman, is added as 17 kap. 3 § brottsbalken (the law amends 17 kap. and the register lists the new 3 §). The proposition says that it largely means the old offence missfirmelse mot tjansteman, repealed in 1976, is reintroduced, with the offence description built on the insult offence and under general prosecution. That is the promised criminalisation of insulting officials such as police; only the name differs. The judge gave full at medium confidence.

val2022-l-sank-skatten-pa-sparande-for-a.label: none
val2022-l-sank-skatten-pa-sparande-for-a.reason: Read in Prop. 2024/25:1 (avsnitt 11.1): the law only adjusts 2 kap. 10 b § of the foreign tax credit act as a consequence of the new ISK deduction; the proposition calls the change technical. The deduction itself is in SFS 2024:1131 and 2024:1132, which stay partial.

val2022-m-sankt-skatt-pa-arbete::sfs-202.label: partial
val2022-m-sankt-skatt-pa-arbete::sfs-202.reason: Label kept (partial); the judge note is replaced by a plain note that names the step of the jobbskatteavdrag cuts, read in the propositions (Prop. 2023/24:13, 2024/25:1 section 12.1, 2025/26:32).
val2022-m-sankt-skatt-pa-arbete::sfs-202.missing_sv: Första förstärkningen av jobbskatteavdraget (11 miljarder kronor från 2024), riktad främst till heltidsarbetande med låga och medelhöga inkomster. Senare steg finns i andra lagar.

val2022-m-sankt-skatt-pa-arbete::sfs-202.label: partial
val2022-m-sankt-skatt-pa-arbete::sfs-202.reason: Label kept (partial); the judge note is replaced by a plain note that names the step of the jobbskatteavdrag cuts, read in the propositions (Prop. 2023/24:13, 2024/25:1 section 12.1, 2025/26:32).
val2022-m-sankt-skatt-pa-arbete::sfs-202.missing_sv: Andra förstärkningen av jobbskatteavdraget och grundavdraget (från 2025), riktad främst till låga och medelhöga inkomster. Lagen innehåller också sparandeavdraget för ISK, som inte rör skatt på arbete.

val2022-m-sankt-skatt-pa-arbete::sfs-202.label: partial
val2022-m-sankt-skatt-pa-arbete::sfs-202.reason: Label kept (partial); the judge note is replaced by a plain note that names the step of the jobbskatteavdrag cuts, read in the propositions (Prop. 2023/24:13, 2024/25:1 section 12.1, 2025/26:32).

Read in Prop. 2024/25:1 section 12.9: this law introduces the tax-free deduction of 150,000 kr from 2025, and the 300,000 kr level is enacted in SFS 2024:1132.
tido-isk-skattefri-grundniva-300000::sfs.missing_sv: Nivån 300 000 kronor från 2026 finns i en annan lag (SFS 2024:1132).

tido-isk-skattefri-grundniva-300000::sfs.label: full
tido-isk-skattefri-grundniva-300000::sfs.reason: Read in Prop. 2024/25:1 section 12.9: the law raises the tax-free deduction on an investment savings account from 150,000 to 300,000 kr from 2026, which is the promised base level.

val2022-sd-skarp-reglerna-om-tvangsgifte.label: full
val2022-sd-skarp-reglerna-om-tvangsgifte.reason: Hand-added: SFS 2026:952 (amends lagen 1904:26 s. 1; in force 2026-07-02 per Prop. 2025/26:213 section 2.4) is not in the SFS store because the 1904 register page is not parsed. It makes the ban on recognising unauthorised foreign marriages apply without exception, which covers the månggifte part.

val2022-sd-skarp-reglerna-om-tvangsgifte.label: partial
val2022-sd-skarp-reglerna-om-tvangsgifte.reason: SFS 2026:951 only removes the fourth paragraph of 5 kap. 5 § äktenskapsbalken as a follow-on change; the ban itself is in SFS 2026:952.
val2022-sd-skarp-reglerna-om-tvangsgifte.missing_sv: Följdändring i äktenskapsbalken: tar bort ett stycke i 5 kap. 5 §.

val2022-mp-ny-konstillhorighetslag-och-t.label: partial
val2022-mp-ny-konstillhorighetslag-och-t.reason: Hand-added: SFS 2024:238 (Lag om fastställande av kön i vissa fall, in force 2025-07-01) came from a committee initiative (Bet. 2023/24:SoU22, no proposition), so the proposition-indexed SFS store does not hold it. It is the new könstillhörighetslag; a third legal sex is not introduced.

val2022-mp-ny-konstillhorighetslag-och-t.label: partial
val2022-mp-ny-konstillhorighetslag-och-t.reason: Hand-added, same committee initiative: the new lag om vissa kirurgiska ingrepp i könsorganen, in force 2025-07-01.

val2022-m-vald-mot-skolpersonal-brottsru.label: partial
val2022-m-vald-mot-skolpersonal-brottsru.reason: Prop. 2022/23:106 extends the offences against tjänsteman (17 kap. 5 § brottsbalken) to utbildningspersonal inom skolväsendet; no separate offence for violence against school staff is created.
val2022-m-vald-mot-skolpersonal-brottsru.missing_sv: Något eget brott för våld mot skolpersonal införs inte.

tido-oversyn-skatter-kraftvarme::sfs-202.label: partial
tido-oversyn-skatter-kraftvarme::sfs-202.reason: Read in Prop. 2022/23:17: exempts fuel used in kraftvärme within the EU emissions trading system from carbon dioxide tax, one of the three taxes in the promise.

val2022-c-sank-skatten-pa-jobb-och-foret.label: partial
val2022-c-sank-skatten-pa-jobb-och-foret.reason: Hand-added in the slice 4 close-out (dl5.12): the law is a step in the jobbskatteavdrag reform that the same law set delivers for the M promise sankt-skatt-pa-arbete; for this C promise (lower tax on jobs and business, especially small firms and the self-employed) it covers the jobs part and is partial.
val2022-c-sank-skatten-pa-jobb-och-foret.missing_sv: Första förstärkningen av jobbskatteavdraget (från 2024), riktad främst till låga och medelhöga inkomster. Senare steg och stödet till småföretag finns i andra lagar.

val2022-c-sank-skatten-pa-jobb-och-foret.label: partial
val2022-c-sank-skatten-pa-jobb-och-foret.reason: Hand-added in the slice 4 close-out (dl5.12): the law is a step in the jobbskatteavdrag reform that the same law set delivers for the M promise sankt-skatt-pa-arbete; for this C promise (lower tax on jobs and business, especially small firms and the self-employed) it covers the jobs part and is partial.
val2022-c-sank-skatten-pa-jobb-och-foret.missing_sv: Andra förstärkningen av jobbskatteavdraget och grundavdraget (från 2025), riktad främst till låga och medelhöga inkomster. Lagen innehåller också sparandeavdraget för ISK, som inte rör skatt på arbete.

val2022-c-sank-skatten-pa-jobb-och-foret.label: partial
val2022-c-sank-skatten-pa-jobb-och-foret.reason: Hand-added in the slice 4 close-out (dl5.12): the law is a step in the jobbskatteavdrag reform that the same law set delivers for the M promise sankt-skatt-pa-arbete; for this C promise (lower tax on jobs and business, especially small firms and the self-employed) it covers the jobs part and is partial.
val2022-c-sank-skatten-pa-jobb-och-foret.missing_sv: Tredje förstärkningen av jobbskatteavdraget (från 2026), tillsammans med höjt grundavdrag för äldre och skattereduktion för sjuk- och aktivitetsersättning.

val2022-c-sank-skatten-pa-jobb-och-foret.label: partial
val2022-c-sank-skatten-pa-jobb-och-foret.reason: Hand-added in the slice 4 close-out (dl5.12): Prop. 2024/25:25 widens the växa-stöd (lower employer contributions when a one-person firm hires, now up to two employees, from 2025-01-01). The växa-stöd sits in lagen (2016:1053), which SFS 2024:1158 amends (3-6 and 9 §§); this delivers the small-business part of the promise. SFS 2024:1156 only follows on in the stödområde law and is not linked.
val2022-c-sank-skatten-pa-jobb-och-foret.missing_sv: Utvidgat växa-stöd: nedsättningen av arbetsgivaravgifterna för enmansföretag som anställer gäller upp till två anställda.

tido-transitcenter-hela-asylprocessen::s.label: partial
tido-transitcenter-hela-asylprocessen::s.reason: Hand-added in the slice 4 close-out (dl5.12): Prop. 2024/25:49 and SFS 2025:57 tie financial assistance during the asylum period to living at the assigned asylum accommodation (the ending of eget boende); transit centres under article 43 of the asylum procedures directive are not introduced, so the compound promise is partial.

tido-transitcenter-hela-asylprocessen::s.label: partial

tido-transitcenter-hela-asylprocessen::s.missing_sv: Följdändring till den nya ordningen för asylsökandes boende.

val2022-s-asylsokande-ska-inte-valja-bos.reason: Hand-added in the slice 4 close-out (dl5.12): Prop. 2024/25:49 and SFS 2025:57 tie financial assistance during the asylum period to living at the assigned asylum accommodation (the ending of eget boende); living privately remains allowed, but without the right to assistance, so the promise that asylum seekers may not choose where to live is delivered in part.

tido-dubbla-straff-gangkriminella::sfs-2.label: full
tido-dubbla-straff-gangkriminella::sfs-2.reason: Rule check of the term-end sweep (hemsida-b0bs): Read in Prop. 2025/26:218: a new straffskärpningsregel for crimes connected to criminal networks where the straffvärde is as a starting point assessed as double, plus a doubled maximum penalty (max 18 years). That is the promise (dubbla straff for gängkriminella).

tido-egenforsorjningskrav-medborgarskap:.label: full
tido-egenforsorjningskrav-medborgarskap:.reason: Rule check of the term-end sweep (hemsida-b0bs): Read in Prop. 2025/26:175: "Det införs ett försörjningskrav vid ansökan om medborgarskap" (section 9.1). That is the promised main rule of a reinstated self-sufficiency requirement.

val2022-l-forsorjningskrav-for-medborgar.label: full
val2022-l-forsorjningskrav-for-medborgar.reason: Rule check of the term-end sweep (hemsida-b0bs): Read in Prop. 2025/26:175: a försörjningskrav is introduced for applicants for citizenship, which is the promise that an applicant must be able to support themselves.

val2022-l-sprakkrav-for-medborgarskap::s.label: full
val2022-l-sprakkrav-for-medborgarskap::s.reason: Rule check of the term-end sweep (hemsida-b0bs): The citizenship test in Swedish (13 and 13 a §§) is the language test the promise asks for, from 2027-10-01 (Prop. 2025/26:175).

tido-mellantvang-socialtjanstlagen::sfs-.label: full
tido-mellantvang-socialtjanstlagen::sfs-.reason: Rule check of the term-end sweep (hemsida-b0bs): Read in Prop. 2025/26:295 (3 kap. 1 §): "Socialnämnden får besluta att en vårdnadshavare ska delta i en eller flera insatser" without consent, with special conditions and vite. This is the mellantvång the promise asks for, in a new law rather than in socialtjänstlagen itself.

tido-proposition-skarpta-villkor-anhorig.label: full
tido-proposition-skarpta-villkor-anhorig.reason: Rule check of the term-end sweep (hemsida-b0bs): Prop. 2023/24:18 is the proposition the promise asks for (stricter conditions for family-reunification immigration: age limit 21, narrower exemption from the maintenance requirement); SFS 2023:652 enacts it.

tido-skolor-stangda-obehoriga::sfs-2025-.label: full
tido-skolor-stangda-obehoriga::sfs-2025-.reason: Rule check of the term-end sweep (hemsida-b0bs): Read in Prop. 2024/25:160: "Huvudmannen ska se till att åtgärder vidtas för att obehöriga personer inte ska ges tillträde till förskole- eller skolenhetens område under tid då verksamheten pågår" (6 a kap. 4 § skollagen). That clarifies the principle that schools are closed to unauthorised persons through a legal amendment.

tido-ta-bort-anvisningsavtal::sfs-2026-1.label: full
tido-ta-bort-anvisningsavtal::sfs-2026-1.reason: Rule check of the term-end sweep (hemsida-b0bs): Prop. 2025/26:240: the new elmarknadslag replaces anvisade elavtal with a leveransskyldig sistahandsleverantör, so the anvisningsavtal are removed (in force 2027-01-01).

val2022-l-pensionsgas::sfs-2026-1301.label: full
val2022-l-pensionsgas::sfs-2026-1301.reason: Rule check of the term-end sweep (hemsida-b0bs): Prop. 2025/26:169: a utdelningsbart överskott (balanstal above 1.1500) and a utdelningsfaktor that raises the pension balances. That is the pensionsgas.

val2022-s-infor-gas-i-pensionssystemet::.label: full
val2022-s-infor-gas-i-pensionssystemet::.reason: Rule check of the term-end sweep (hemsida-b0bs): Prop. 2025/26:169: a utdelningsbart överskott and a utdelningsfaktor that raises the pension balances, so the pension is higher when a surplus arises. That is the gas the promise asks for.

val2022-m-hogkostnadsskydd-ny-karnkraft:.label: full
val2022-m-hogkostnadsskydd-ny-karnkraft:.reason: Rule check of the term-end sweep (hemsida-b0bs): Read in Prop. 2024/25:150: state loans and two-way contracts for difference (minimum-revenue protection and a cap on overcompensation) with an explicit risk- and value-sharing model for cost overruns in the construction of new reactors. That is the state cost protection the promise asks for.

tido-arbetstillstand-krav-sjukforsakring.label: weaker
tido-arbetstillstand-krav-sjukforsakring.reason: Rule check of the term-end sweep (hemsida-b0bs): Read in Prop. 2025/26:87: the requirement of a comprehensive health insurance applies to stays up to one year, and it is enough that the foreigner has applied for the insurance. The promise is an arranged insurance for the whole first permit period, so the law delivers a weaker variant.
tido-arbetstillstand-krav-sjukforsakring.missing_sv: Kravet gäller vistelser på högst ett år och det räcker att utlänningen har ansökt om försäkringen.

val2022-l-sank-arbetsgivaravgiften-for-a.label: weaker
val2022-l-sank-arbetsgivaravgiften-for-a.reason: Rule check of the term-end sweep (hemsida-b0bs): Prop. 2025/26:66: the lowered employer contributions for young employees apply only to remuneration paid from 2026-04-01 to 2027-09-30 and up to 25 000 kr per month, so the promise is delivered as a temporary, capped reduction.
val2022-l-sank-arbetsgivaravgiften-for-a.missing_sv: Nedsättningen är tidsbegränsad (1 april 2026 till 30 september 2027) och gäller ersättning upp till 25 000 kronor i månaden.

val2022-l-statliga-lanegarantier-omfatta.label: partial
val2022-l-statliga-lanegarantier-omfatta.reason: Rule check of the term-end sweep (hemsida-b0bs): Read in Prop. 2024/25:150: the support is given as state loans (and two-way contracts for difference); loan guarantees are the instrument the promise names. The law gives state financing support to nuclear power in another form.
val2022-l-statliga-lanegarantier-omfatta.missing_sv: Stödet ges som statliga lån och differenskontrakt, inte som lånegarantier.

val2022-m-dubbla-straff-gangkriminella::.label: full
val2022-m-dubbla-straff-gangkriminella::.reason: Rule check of the term-end sweep (hemsida-b0bs): Same law and reading as tido-dubbla-straff-gangkriminella: Prop. 2025/26:218 makes the straffvärde as a starting point double for crimes linked to criminal networks, with a doubled maximum penalty.

val2022-l-obligatoriska-insatser-for-fam.label: full
val2022-l-obligatoriska-insatser-for-fam.reason: Rule check of the term-end sweep (hemsida-b0bs): Same law and reading as tido-mellantvang-socialtjanstlagen: Prop. 2025/26:295 3 kap. 1 §, the socialnämnd may order a vårdnadshavare to take part in interventions without consent, which is the promise that more family interventions can be mandatory.

val2022-sd-battre-kontaktforbud::sfs-202.label: full
val2022-sd-battre-kontaktforbud::sfs-202.reason: Rule check of the term-end sweep (hemsida-b0bs): Same law and reading as tido-utokat-kontaktforbud: Prop. 2024/25:123 (HC03123) adds a new ground (otillbörlig övervakning), a presumption after serious crimes in close relationships, protection of complainants and witnesses and larger areas, which is the promise that the possibilities for contact bans are improved.
